title: Commit messages row reads its own CI job
summary: The `osf status` pull-request block used to print a hardcoded 'not run' for the Commit messages row because no check linted commit messages. This change gives that scan its own CI job named `commit messages` (so it gets its own check run), teaches `parse_gates` to pull that job's result out of the gate list into a dedicated `commit_scan` field, and renders the row from it: passed with a description of what is covered, failed with the scan's reason, or 'not run' when no result was reported. The CI row deliberately excludes the commit-scan entry so one result is not counted twice.

nodes.label: ci.yml
nodes.subtitle: GitHub Actions workflow
nodes.summary: The workflow gains a dedicated `commit-messages` job, gated on pull_request, that checks out with full history, caches the cargo build, builds the `osf` binary and runs `osf scan --commits`. The scan step moved out of the shared job so its result becomes its own check run.

nodes.label: commit messages job
nodes.subtitle: name: commit messages
nodes.summary: A new job whose name is the check-run name the status block looks for. It runs only on pull requests and produces the pass/fail result the Commit messages row reads.

nodes.label: osf scan --commits
nodes.subtitle: commit-message lint
nodes.summary: The existing scan over the commits a pull request adds: session links, agent state paths, co-author trailers, local paths, foreign repository references, secrets and private names. Unchanged; only its job placement moved.

nodes.label: pr_status::render
nodes.subtitle: render(&RenderInput) -> String
nodes.summary: The status block renderer. The hardcoded Commit messages row is replaced by a call to `gates.commit_row()`, whose result and details are interpolated into the markdown table.

nodes.label: GateSummary
nodes.subtitle: struct GateSummary
nodes.summary: The parsed view of the gate spec. It gains a `commit_scan: Option<Result<(), String>>` field so the commit-message result is held separately from the pass/fail counters that feed the CI row.

nodes.label: GateSummary::commit_row
nodes.subtitle: fn commit_row(&self) -> (String, String)
nodes.summary: Maps the stored commit-scan result to a result cell and a details cell: passed with the coverage description, failed with the scan's reason (or a generic message when the reason is empty), and 'not run' with an explanation when no result was reported. Never renders as passed without a result.

nodes.label: parse_gates
nodes.subtitle: fn parse_gates(spec: &str)
nodes.summary: Parses the `name: result` gate list. Entries named `commit messages` are routed into `commit_scan` instead of the total/passed counters, so the CI row's counts exclude the commit scan while the Commit messages row reads it.

nodes.label: GateSummary::ci_row
nodes.subtitle: fn ci_row(&self)
nodes.summary: Renders the CI row from the total/passed/failed counters. Unchanged in itself, but its inputs now exclude the commit-scan entry.

nodes.label: COMMIT_SCAN_CHECK
nodes.subtitle: pub const &str = "commit messages"
nodes.summary: The single source of truth for the check-run name, shared by the parser and the row renderer so the job name and the lookup cannot drift apart.

nodes.label: COMMIT_SCAN_COVERS
